items.title: Danger Zone Pack

items.name: india-pack
items.title: India Pack
items.description: India-aware identity, payment and amount inputs.

items.name: checkout-pack
items.title: Checkout Pack
items.description: Prevent payment mistakes before customers submit.

items.name: signup-login-pack
items.title: Sign-up Pack
items.description: Catch account-creation mistakes early.

items.name: account-settings-pack
items.title: Settings Pack
items.description: Make account changes easier to review and recover.

items.name: forms-pack
items.title: Forms Pack
items.description: Keep form entries, drafts and submissions on track.

items.name: messaging-pack
items.title: Messaging Pack
items.description: Review recipients, attachments and sensitive text before sending.

items.name: devtools-pack
items.title: Dev Tools Pack
items.description: Keep risky developer actions in the right environment.

items.name: scheduling-pack
items.title: Scheduling Pack
items.description: Avoid date, timezone and overlap mistakes.

items.name: agent-action-approve
items.title: Agent Action Approve
items.description: Reads an agent's tool call and says plainly what it will delete, send or change, how far it reaches and whether it can be undone. Marks risky tokens, compares the agent's claim with the call, makes dangerous calls hold-to-approve and refuses risky "always allow" rules.

items.name: ai-paste-guard
items.title: AI Paste Guard
items.description: Reads the HTML clipboard data pasted into an AI prompt box and holds it when it carries invisible text (same-colour, zero-size, display:none, off-screen, comments, alt/title instructions, Unicode tag payloads), shows each hidden passage and can paste only the visible text.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: Deferred actions with an undo window: actions apply optimistically and commit only after a countdown that pauses on hover, focus or a hidden tab, with Ctrl/⌘+Z, a commit on page close (pagehide), and a rollback notice if the commit fails.

items.name: mcp-tool-review
items.title: MCP Tool Review
items.description: Review card for MCP tool changes after approval: fingerprints each definition, diffs the description word by word, marks injected instructions (<IMPORTANT> blocks, "do not tell the user", ~/.ssh, other servers' tools), new free-text parameters and flipped read-only hints.

items.name: reset-hard-readback
items.title: Reset Hard Readback
items.description: Readback for destructive git commands from porcelain status: edited files with +/- lines, staged new files, untracked and ignored files (.env and keys first), commits the branch moves past with unpushed ones marked, stash ids to recover, what stays, and a stash-first option.

items.name: account-deletion-readback
items.title: Account Deletion Readback
items.description: Before Delete, lists what goes, sole-owner teams (with transfer), App Store / Google Play plans that keep billing until cancelled there, the restore deadline, what is kept and a data export. Delete unlocks after a typed confirmation and can wait for the paid period to end.

items.name: force-push-confirm
items.title: Force Push Confirm
items.description: Lists every commit a force push would drop with author, message and age, marks other people's commits and protected branches, builds a --force-with-lease command pinned to the tip shown (or --force-if-includes), and asks you to type the branch name.

items.name: infra-plan-readback
items.title: Infra Plan Readback
items.description: Reads a `terraform show -json` plan as create, update, replace and destroy counts, lists stateful destroys and replacements first with the attribute forcing each, and keeps Apply locked until each loss is acknowledged (and, in production, the workspace typed).

items.name: recovery-contact-cooldown
items.title: Recovery Contact Cooldown
items.description: Shows a pending recovery-contact change: the masked new contact, a countdown to when it applies, that codes still go to the old contact, an urgent state in the last hour, a cancel button and a "this wasn't me" path. Announces the outcome, not the ticking.

items.name: migration-preview
items.title: Migration Preview
items.description: Postgres migration reader (strings, dollar quotes, comments handled) showing what each step locks, which rewrite big tables and which drops can't be undone, and catching failing NOT NULL adds, mid-deploy renames, CONCURRENTLY in a transaction and no lock_timeout.

items.name: feature-flag-rollout
items.title: Feature Flag Rollout
items.description: Reads back who gets the flag (segments plus a percentage of everyone else, in users), asks for a second click before production skips ramp steps or gets ahead of staging, and warns how many users lose the feature on a pullback.

items.name: branch-target
items.title: Branch Target
items.description: Checks the chosen base against branch rules (feature → main is caught, with a one-tap switch to develop), counts commits the branch would drag in that aren't its own, and flags a head that is behind its target with an Update branch action.

items.name: session-list
items.title: Session List
items.description: Signed-in sessions list with this device pinned and marked, "Sign out all others" that never includes it, an inline confirm (Cancel focused) before signing out here, and sessions from another country flagged with "approximate location" wording.

items.name: sign-in-approve
items.title: Sign-in Approve
items.description: Sign-in approval prompt with no one-tap Approve: the user types the number from the sign-in screen, sees location and device, is warned about request bursts and "support" asking for codes, and every denial ends on a secure-my-account step.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: Button that runs onConfirm only after a full press-and-hold by mouse, touch or keyboard, rewinds on early release, shows "Hold to confirm" on a plain click, and lets users who can't hold (screen reader, switch access) confirm with a second press.

items.name: two-step-button
items.title: Two-Step Button
items.description: Destructive button where the first click arms it with a draining timer and a second deliberate click confirms; accidental double-clicks, held keys, blur, Escape or the timeout all disarm it.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to Confirm
items.description: Slide-to-confirm control where the thumb must travel the whole track (threshold), a held arrow key stops short of the end, an async confirm shows a pending state, and a rejection slides it back.

items.name: type-to-confirm
items.title: Type to Confirm
items.description: GitHub-style confirm dialog (native <dialog>) that unlocks only after the exact phrase is typed, highlighting matched characters and flagging a typo the moment it happens; errors keep the dialog open.

items.name: impact-preview
items.title: Impact Preview
items.description: Delete confirmation that loads every dependent of a parent object, grouped by type with counts and samples and marked deleted, detached or kept, and keeps Confirm locked until the list has loaded.

items.name: bulk-scope-confirm
items.title: Bulk Scope Confirm
items.description: States the exact count and risky subsets ("including 12 you don't own"), defaults to only the selected items on this page, and locks Confirm if the match count changes while the dialog is open.

items.name: drop-confirm
items.title: Drop Confirm
items.description: The target names exactly what will move and where, ignores a drop before the pointer has rested on it, asks once before large moves or moves that change who can see the items, and offers Undo, with a Move here button for keyboard and touch.

items.name: danger-zone
items.title: Danger Zone
items.description: Destructive actions stay listed with their consequences but locked until the user deliberately unlocks the section, which relocks after one action, an idle timeout (60 s default), Escape, a hidden tab or focus leaving it.

items.name: click-shield
items.title: Click Shield
items.description: Wraps a control and ignores pointer presses for about 500 ms after it appears, shifts, changes its label or the tab regains focus, with a quiet fade-in cue. Keyboard users are only shielded from focus that code moved onto the control.

items.name: shortcut-confirm
items.title: Shortcut Confirm
items.description: Two-press guard for destructive shortcuts: the first press shows "Press ⌘⌫ again to delete 3 items", and only a separate second press within the window confirms. Held keys, extra modifiers, stray keys in between and keystrokes in text fields don't count.

items.name: guarded-switch
items.title: Guarded Switch
items.description: Toggle for critical settings with a see-through cover, like an aircraft switch guard: lift it first, it states what flipping will do while open, drops back on its own after a few seconds, and reads back the consequence after the change. Red tone for irreversible effects.

items.name: swipe-delete-row
items.title: Swipe Delete Row
items.description: Swipe-to-delete row that deletes only when dragged past a visible line (not on a fast flick or vertical scroll), resists like a rubber band, springs back if released early, has a trash button for keyboard users and keeps an Undo before the delete commits.

items.name: grace-send
items.title: Grace Send
items.description: Send button with a grace window: pressing it starts a countdown ring before your onSend runs, so Cancel, Escape or a leave-page warning can stop it; Send now skips the wait. Shows pending, sent, cancelled and failed states.

items.name: two-person-approve
items.title: Two-Person Approve
items.description: Approval UI for high-risk actions that surfaces the two-person rule: the requester can't approve their own request here, approval is tied to a fingerprint of the exact plan so edits need re-review, rejections need a reason, and expired requests can't be approved.

items.name: trash-countdown
items.title: Trash Countdown
items.description: Trash list showing time left before each item is purged, highlighting soon-to-go items, with one-tap restore, and an empty-trash confirm that needs the typed item count and resets if new items arrive mid-confirmation.

items.name: range-select-guard
items.title: Range Select Guard
items.description: Selectable list that reads back how many rows a shift-click range selected (with Undo), skips and reports rows hidden by the filter, flags rows on pages never opened with an "only this page" fix, and calls out selected rows a filter now hides.

items.name: reauth-gate
items.title: Reauth Gate
items.description: Step-up prompt for sensitive actions. Checks a passkey, password or PIN through your own verify function, names the action and why it asks, runs the queued action after confirmation, and remembers it for a short window shown as an endable countdown chip.

items.name: rollback-preview
items.title: Rollback Preview
items.description: Rollback confirmation listing what reverts, what won't undo (irreversible migrations, data written since), the target's age and every newer version skipped. Confirms only when the target's name is typed, and calls out a different version's name instead of silently not matching.

items.name: edit-lock
items.title: Edit Lock
items.description: Locks the form in a disabled fieldset ("Locked by Priya after approval"), says before unlocking that any change needs re-approval, voids the approval only when something actually changes, and relocks after idleness, never mid-typing.

items.name: archive-or-delete
items.title: Archive or Delete
items.description: Shows Archive and Delete together with each affected thing's fate under both. The reversible choice starts selected and focused so Enter archives; choosing Delete highlights what is lost and relabels the button "Delete forever".

items.name: revoke-access-preview
items.title: Revoke Access Preview
items.description: Pre-removal readback for members, tokens or apps: what they lose, what they own with a reassign picker and one-tap reassign-all, sessions that end (flagging any in use now) and integrations that stop on their credentials. The button says if anything stays unowned.

items.name: transfer-ownership
items.title: Transfer Ownership
items.description: Ownership transfer that reads back what moves and what you keep, warns when the email is outside your org with a one-tap switch to the colleague you probably meant, blocks a recipient whose plan can't own it, and transfers only once they accept, showing the pending request.

items.name: cancel-readback
items.title: Cancel Readback
items.description: The cancel screen reads back the exact date and time access ends, what is lost and kept, and the refund (or plainly that there is none), offers pause or downgrade once below a cancel button that never moves, and ends on a receipt with undo.

items.name: merge-records
items.title: Merge Records
items.description: Duplicate merge panel where each field defaults to the most recent non-empty value, real conflicts are marked (ignoring case and spacing), and a live readback names every value that will be discarded, which record keeps its ID and which links move to it.

items.name: move-readback
items.title: Move Readback
items.description: Move confirmation that reads back the destination path with the folder setting access highlighted, how many people gain or lose access, path links that break (with a redirect option) and inherited settings that change, and relabels the button when access widens.

items.name: reset-preview
items.title: Reset Preview
items.description: Reset-to-defaults preview listing only the settings the user changed as current → default, with per-setting keep checkboxes, an export nudge until a copy is saved, and a draining Undo after the reset.

items.name: replace-file
items.title: Replace File
items.description: Name-clash resolver for uploads: both copies side by side with thumbnail, size and date, a warning plus one-tap Keep both when an older file would replace a newer one, identical copies spotted, renamed-copy preview, and apply-to-all with counts.

items.name: dns-record-guard
items.title: DNS Record Guard
items.description: Checks a DNS change against the zone: a removed MX, SPF senders dropped or past the 10-lookup limit, a removed DKIM selector (escalated under enforcing DMARC), a CNAME at the root or beside other records and dangling names, then says how long it takes to spread.

items.name: key-rotate
items.title: Key Rotate
items.description: Rotation panel that keeps old and new API keys valid until a stated time, shows which clients use the new key, flags rare jobs that won't call before the old key expires, and holds an immediate cut-off while the old key is in use unless it leaked.

items.name: retention-change
items.title: Retention Change
items.description: Retention picker that states what a shorter period deletes and when ("deletes 14,210 events older than 13 Sep, tonight at 02:00"), shades the doomed days on a chart, counts down while undoing is still free, and labels confirm "Delete without export" until exported.

items.name: seat-reduce
items.title: Seat Reduce
items.description: Seat-reduction flow that asks who goes, suggests unaccepted invites then least-active members (never owners or admins), warns when you pick an admin or someone active today, and shows the new bill, when it starts and what happens to each person's work.

items.name: cooldown-button
items.title: Cooldown Button
items.description: Escalating cooldowns per attempt (30s, 60s, 120s) with a visible countdown and reason, and a lock once attempts run out. The deadline is kept in sessionStorage, so a refresh in the same tab keeps it; a new tab or cleared storage does not.

items.name: safe-submit
items.title: Safe Submit
items.description: Submit button that runs one request at a time, ignores repeat clicks, Enter spam and double-taps, and hands your onSubmit an idempotency key that is reused on retry after a network error or 408/429/5xx so the server can dedupe.

items.name: bulk-runner
items.title: Bulk Runner
items.description: Shows live done/failed/remaining counts. Pause and Stop let in-flight items finish, then say exactly what was and wasn't done. Failures are grouped by reason with retry-failed-only, and progress never jumps backwards.

items.name: spend-cap-button
items.title: Spend Cap Button
items.description: Buy button that remembers recent purchases of the same item ("You bought this 3 min ago") and needs a deliberate second click to buy again, previews the purchase against each cap, and refuses in the UI any spend that would break a cap, with the overage and reset time.

items.name: scheduled-queue
items.title: Scheduled Queue
items.description: Queue of scheduled sends that counts down each row, highlights the last-chance window before the real cancel cutoff, offers a one-tap move for sends landing in quiet hours where the audience lives, flags missed sends, and refuses past reschedule times.

items.name: commit-combobox
items.title: Commit Combobox
items.description: Unpicked text is matched on blur (an exact match is picked, a misspelling gets a Did you mean, duplicate names ask which), editing after a pick visibly drops it with Undo or Esc, and the stored option is always read back.

items.name: relative-date-input
items.title: Relative Date Input
items.description: Reads "next Fri", "in 2 weeks", "the 15th" or "23 Oct" against today with date-fns. When a phrase can mean two dates ("next Friday" on a Wednesday, "the 10th" once passed), it shows both and waits for a pick, then offers a rewrite to the explicit date.

items.name: namesake-select
items.title: Namesake Select
items.description: Person picker that flags options sharing a name (ignoring case, accents and word order) with only the details that tell them apart, asks for one identifier before a shared name becomes the value, offers a switch when the answer fits the other person, and reads the choice back.

items.name: cheque-check
items.title: Cheque Check
items.description: Reads the date as written in the CTS boxes (so 31 November is caught), shows the safe deposit window under RBI's three-month rule with a warning on the disputed last day, catches stale January dates and two-digit years, and says when Positive Pay applies.

items.name: kyc-name-match
items.title: KYC Name Match
items.description: KYC name field that compares the typed name with each document word by word (order, initials, missing middle name, transliterations like Laxmi/Lakshmi), checks the PAN's 4th and 5th letters, flags differing date of birth or gender, and offers each exact name.

items.name: aadhaar-input
items.title: Aadhaar Input
items.description: Masks Aadhaar entry as XXXX XXXX 1234 (reveal on demand), checks the Verhoeff check digit and the no-0-or-1 first digit, recognises a VID, enrolment ID, masked copy, PAN or mobile pasted by mistake, strips photocopy separators and says how the number is stored.

items.name: password-policy-input
items.title: Password Policy Input
items.description: Password policy editor that checks rules against NIST SP 800-63B-4 (composition rules, forced rotation, security questions, hints, minimum under 15 or 8 with MFA, maximum under 64, blocked paste, no breach check or attempt limit), shows sample passwords and applies defaults.

items.name: passenger-name-input
items.title: Passenger Name Input
items.description: Passenger name field that checks against the ID and catches swapped names, a missing middle name, titles, suffixes or nicknames in the name, single-name passengers, accents the ticket can't print and names over the airline's limit, with fixes and a SURNAME/GIVEN TITLE readback.

items.name: email-change-guard
items.title: Email Change Guard
items.description: Catches misspelled providers (gmial.con) with a one-tap fix, shows where the confirmation stops matching, spots the same inbox (Gmail dots, +tags), says what moves with the address, and keeps the old address active until the new one is verified, with resend, edit and cancel.

items.name: invoice-number-check
items.title: Invoice Number Check
items.description: GST invoice number field that counts to 16, names characters other than letters, digits, - or /, catches a number already used this financial year (case-insensitively), a stale year token, skipped or reused counters and gaps, and offers the next number.

items.name: pin-drop-check
items.title: Pin Drop Check
items.description: Map-pin check that measures the pin against the geocoded address and PIN area (ignoring gaps inside GPS accuracy), flags pins in water or on a highway from your geo helper, draws the gap on a to-scale SVG sketch with no map library, and asks "Use pin or address?".

items.name: pincode-input
items.title: PIN Code Input
items.description: Indian PIN field that reads the state from the first digits offline and flags a mismatch with the picked state, catches O typed for 0, wrong lengths, unused prefixes, Army Post codes and ZIP or UK postcodes typed for India, then checks the area and city through your lookup.

items.name: password-hint-guard
items.title: Password Hint Guard
items.description: Hint or security-answer field that spots the password inside it (also backwards, spaced out or in leetspeak), a large piece of it, or a "same as my bank" reuse admission, without displaying the password, and removes the leak in one tap.

items.name: coupon-input
items.title: Coupon Input
items.description: Cleans pasted spaces, hidden characters and case, catches O-vs-0 look-alikes with a fix, says why a code didn't apply (cart minimum and the gap, expiry, excluded items, already used), shows the real saving and any cap, and asks before a worse code replaces a better one.

items.name: paste-target-guard
items.title: Paste Target Guard
items.description: Payment-target field that compares what lands in it with what was copied on the page or entered earlier, flags look-alikes of saved recipients, and shows both side by side in groups (ends first, differing characters marked) with the original one tap away.

items.name: email-input
items.title: Email Input
items.description: Spots misspelled domains like gmial.con or rediffmial.com with Damerau-Levenshtein matching and offers a one-tap, never automatic, fix; can suggest matching providers while the domain is being typed.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field that warns as it happens about Caps Lock, a non-Latin keyboard layout (from the physical key vs the character typed) and leading or trailing spaces from a paste, with a one-tap trim and a press-and-hold or toggle peek.

items.name: match-field
items.title: Match Field
items.description: Enter-twice field for passwords and account numbers that shows the position where the confirmation stops matching without revealing either value, and refuses a paste into the confirm box only when it is a copy of the first entry, so password managers keep working.

items.name: amount-input
items.title: Amount Input
items.description: Groups digits live with Intl.NumberFormat (lakh/crore for en-IN), spells the amount cheque-style, and when you pass `typical` warns about an amount `threshold`× (default 10×) above or below it, with a one-tap fix for a zero slip. Reports a number plus the exact decimal and minor-unit strings.

items.name: date-sanity-input
items.title: Date Sanity Input
items.description: Reads the weekday back and catches year typos, past or future dates on the wrong side of today (per `expect`), dates implausibly far away and weekends, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: clean-paste-input
items.title: Clean Paste Input
items.description: Strips zero-width, BOM, soft-hyphen and bidi control characters on paste, says what was removed with an undo, and flags any that arrive by typing or autofill with a one-tap fix.

items.name: otp-paste-input
items.title: OTP Paste Input
items.description: One-time-code field that extracts the code from a pasted SMS or email, skipping phone numbers, amounts, account endings and order numbers (a run near "code" or "OTP" wins), and accepts digits typed or pasted in any script (full-width, Devanagari, Arabic-Indic).

items.name: url-input
items.title: URL Input
items.description: URL field that adds a missing https://, flags http, Cyrillic or Greek lookalike hostnames (decoding punycode) and a "paypal.com@" prefix that hides the real site, fixes typo'd endings like .con, trims sentence leftovers and strips tracking parameters in one tap.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: Phone field that cleans pasted input (separators, a leading 0, a doubled +91), picks the country from the dial and area code (+1 416 is Canada), warns on wrong digit counts, checks ranges and line types with libphonenumber, and reads back the E.164 value.

items.name: char-budget
items.title: Character Budget
items.description: Counts graphemes against several limits at once (X, SMS segments, LinkedIn, meta description), names the curly quote or emoji that forced UCS-2 SMS encoding, and can swap them for plain characters in one tap.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code Input
items.description: Disables autocorrect, autocapitalise and spellcheck, catches smart quotes, en/em dashes, ellipses and hidden characters by line and column with a one-tap fix, and can validate JSON.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Click-to-edit text: a cancelled edit can be restored, a failed save keeps your draft, and a value changed by someone else mid-edit is flagged instead of silently overwritten (clicking away then keeps the editor open rather than saving).

items.name: checksum-input
items.title: Checksum Input
items.description: Checks mod-97 (IBAN), Luhn (card) and ISBN check digits, IBAN country lengths and IFSC format as you type, then highlights the one swapped or doubled character that explains a failure instead of guessing a digit.

items.name: name-input
items.title: Name Input
items.description: Name field that spots caps lock, all-lowercase, stray digits, doubled spaces and a first/last mix-up, and offers, never forces, a fix cased the way McDonald, O'Brien, van der Berg and de la Cruz are really written, with a Keep option.

items.name: near-duplicate-input
items.title: Near-Duplicate Input
items.description: Create field that spots near-duplicates as you type (capitals, spacing, punctuation, plurals, one-letter typos, never different numbers like Q3 vs Q4) and offers Use existing, which is also what Enter does.

items.name: slug-input
items.title: Slug Input
items.description: Slug field that follows the title with proper transliteration (Straße → strasse) until published, reads back the full URL, checks collisions as you type with the next free slug one tap away, and warns that editing a live slug breaks links, keeping a redirect by default.

items.name: homoglyph-guard
items.title: Homoglyph Guard
items.description: Username and domain field that detects look-alike, mixed-script, styled (math bold, fullwidth) and zero-width characters following UTS #39 ideas, names each character's script and code point, flags imitations of protected names, and offers the plain-ASCII version in one tap.

items.name: contrast-picker
items.title: Contrast Picker
items.description: Shows the WCAG 2 contrast ratio truncated, never rounded up (#777 on white is 4.47:1 and fails), with AA/AAA marks for normal and large text, and a one-tap nearest passing colour that changes only lightness so the hue stays on brand.

items.name: address-check
items.title: Address Check
items.description: Catches a missing flat or house number, a postcode that doesn't fit the country (or fits another one), a city the postcode lookup places elsewhere and PO boxes couriers can't reach, with one-tap fixes and a live readback of the printed label.

items.name: tax-id-input
items.title: Tax ID Input
items.description: Tax number field for GSTIN, PAN and EU VAT that recomputes the GSTIN's mod-36 check character, reads back state, holder type and country, and pinpoints the wrong character with a one-tap fix for look-alikes, swaps and GR instead of EL.

items.name: filename-input
items.title: Filename Input
items.description: Selects only the base name on focus, warns with a one-tap undo when the extension changes or disappears, and catches illegal characters, Windows reserved names (CON, NUL.txt), trailing dots and spaces, over-long names and duplicates differing only in case.

items.name: coordinate-input
items.title: Coordinate Input
items.description: Reads decimal, DMS and pasted map links (taking Google's pin, not the map centre), catches swapped latitude and longitude, flipped west/south signs against an expected area and 0, 0 defaults, and reads each point back with an OpenStreetMap link.

items.name: zero-result-rescue
items.title: Zero Result Rescue
items.description: Empty-search helper that explains what got in the way and offers only fixes that return results: did-you-mean from your vocabulary, the query retyped in the right layout or without Caps Lock, dropping the filter that hides everything, or all categories, each with a count.

items.name: mixed-value-field
items.title: Mixed Value Field
items.description: Bulk-edit field that shows "Mixed (3 values)" with the distribution instead of a blank or the first record's value, leaves each record alone unless you pick a value, and reads back exactly what saving changes, counting only records that actually change.

items.name: card-expiry-input
items.title: Card Expiry Input
items.description: Masks MM/YY, reads the date back as valid through the month's last day, and catches month 13, the year typed first, a four-digit year, an expired card and one that runs out before the next renewal, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: username-input
items.title: Username Input
items.description: Username field that reads back the exact stored handle, blocks reserved words even in disguise (adm1n) and case-only duplicates, flags lookalikes of existing names with a UTS #39-style skeleton, and checks availability after a pause with free alternatives.

items.name: ifsc-input
items.title: IFSC Input
items.description: IFSC field that catches the letter O typed for the fixed zero, a missing 0, digits in the bank code and guessed prefixes (AXIS for UTIB), then reads the branch back from your lookup (Razorpay IFSC API shape) and warns when it belongs to a different bank than the one picked.

items.name: upi-id-input
items.title: UPI ID Input
items.description: UPI ID field that cleans pasted upi://pay links and catches emails, typo'd handles (@okaxsi), app names as handles (@gpay), wrong-length or +91 phone IDs and older @paytm IDs, then reads back the registered name from your check and flags a mismatch.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut Recorder
items.description: Shortcut recorder that checks the combo against browser and OS reserved keys on every platform (Ctrl+W, ⌘Q, Ctrl+T), the app's own bindings and keys that need AltGr on some layouts, then reads it back as ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl on Windows/Linux.

items.name: hashtag-input
items.title: Hashtag Input
items.description: Hashtag field that flags characters ending a tag early (spaces, apostrophes), all-digit tags that never link, case-only duplicates, banned tags and posts over a platform's limit, and suggests CamelCase (#OpenSource) so screen readers say the words. One-tap fixes.

items.name: timezone-picker
items.title: Timezone Picker
items.description: Time zone search by city, country or abbreviation, listing every meaning of ambiguous abbreviations (IST, CST) instead of guessing, with local time and UTC offset per result, warnings for an upcoming clock change and a zone that differs from the device's.

items.name: scope-picker
items.title: Scope Picker
items.description: API-key scope picker that reads back in plain words what the key can do (destructive powers in red), flags write, delete and admin scopes, offers "Only what you've used" from real usage, and warns when the key never expires.

items.name: brand-color-input
items.title: Brand Color Input
items.description: Names the closest palette token with a perceptual (OKLab) distance and offers a one-tap snap when a value is slightly off (#1e40ae vs #1e40af); catches pasted junk, O for 0, wrong digit counts, alpha in 4/8-digit hex and Android #AARRGGBB order.

items.name: wrong-layout-input
items.title: Wrong Layout Input
items.description: Text input that catches text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (Russian, Hebrew, Greek, Hindi InScript against US QWERTY) using letter-pair models, offers the retyped text as a one-tap fix with undo, and leaves names, acronyms, links and code alone.

items.name: fx-send-receive
items.title: FX Send Receive
items.description: Send/receive pair for international transfers. Locks the side you typed, works out the other from rate and fees, compares what arrives with the invoice, and flags the invoice typed into "You send", a currency mismatch, SHA deductions and overpaying, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: epoch-input
items.title: Epoch Input
items.description: Reads the value back in the user's zone and UTC, and catches milliseconds pasted as seconds, micro- and nanoseconds, Excel serials, Windows FILETIME, .NET ticks, ISO strings without a zone, date-only strings read as UTC midnight and impossible dates like 30 Feb.

items.name: notice-period-check
items.title: Notice Period Check
items.description: Notice calculator that works out the last day from the resignation and policy (days, weeks or months; calendar or working days) and flags month-end arithmetic, weekend or holiday last days, HR's time zone dating the email differently, unpaid leave, leave set-off and buyout cost.

items.name: tax-regime-compare
items.title: Tax Regime Compare
items.description: Old vs new regime tax for salaried residents in India, tax year 2026-27, from salary, HRA (50% cities per rule 279), 80C, 80D, NPS and home-loan interest. Shows break-even deductions and flags a costlier choice, deductions the new regime ignores and over-limit claims.

items.name: emi-readback
items.title: EMI Readback
items.description: Reads back EMI, total interest, processing fee with GST, other upfront charges, the amount that reaches the account and the APR computed as in RBI's Key Facts Statement, catching tenure in the wrong unit, monthly rates typed as yearly, flat rates and heavy fees.

items.name: leave-request-check
items.title: Leave Request Check
items.description: Leave request field that reads the range as calendar days, working days and leave really used, and flags weekend or holiday ends, a sandwich rule charging days between, half days with no half or a gap, a negative balance and teammates away, with fixes.

items.name: ctc-breakdown-input
items.title: CTC Breakdown Input
items.description: Splits CTC into fixed pay, variable, ESOPs, joining bonus, gratuity and PF, estimates gratuity and PF in one tap, works out monthly in-hand pay under India's new tax regime with every assumption written down, and flags offers where in-hand is far below the headline.

items.name: guest-count-picker
items.title: Guest Count Picker
items.description: Guest picker for adults, children and infants that asks each child's age, then flags a child over the age limit (or young enough to be a free infant), infants with no adult, rooms over capacity or out of cots, and a room split that doesn't match the party, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: salary-input
items.title: Salary Input
items.description: Salary field that reads "12 LPA", "85k/month" or "1.2 Cr", catches monthly entered as yearly (and back), a bare number meant as lakhs, and an extra zero against the role's range, reads amounts back per month and per year, and offers one-tap fixes.

items.name: size-fit-picker
items.title: Size Fit Picker
items.description: Size picker that converts UK, US, EU and IN sizes live without losing the pick, reads back the shopper's usual size adjusted for brands that run small or large, and catches their usual number clicked in the wrong system with a one-tap fix.

items.name: unit-input
items.title: Unit Input
items.description: Measurement input that notices when a value is far more plausible in another unit (70 cm is probably inches, 98.6 °C is °F) or is typed as 5'9", and offers a one-tap conversion at the right precision or a unit switch.

items.name: time-confirm
items.title: Time Confirm
items.description: Time input that asks AM or PM when a time is ambiguous, spells out noon and midnight, catches times a DST change skips (one-tap move to the real time) or repeats (pick which), and shows the moment in other zones with day-shift flags.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity Stepper
items.description: Quantity stepper that clamps to min, max and stock with an explanation, rounds to pack sizes, holds big typed jumps for a "Did you mean 10?" confirmation, ignores the scroll wheel and accelerates on long-press.

items.name: percent-input
items.title: Percent Input
items.description: Percent field that catches 0.15 typed for 15%, 0.25 basis points meant as 25, and values outside the allowed range (150% where 100% is the cap), reads the result back in money (15% of ₹2,000 = ₹300) and offers a one-tap fix.

items.name: range-pair
items.title: Range Pair
items.description: From/to field pair that catches reversed ends (moving a 28 Dec → 3 Jan end into next year rather than just swapping), equal exclusive ends, and year or extra-zero typos that make a range huge, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: schedule-readback
items.title: Schedule Readback
items.description: Cron input that reads the expression back in plain English, lists the next runs in your time zone beside the scheduler's, and catches every-minute stars, day-of-month OR day-of-week, the 31st skipping months and 30 February, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: split-allocator
items.title: Split Allocator
items.description: Split editor that shows what's left as you type, gives the rest to any row in one tap, flags rows on 0, and rounds every automatic split with largest remainder so it sums to the total exactly (100 / 3 → 34, 33, 33).

items.name: duration-input
items.title: Duration Input
items.description: Parses 1h30, 90m, 1.5h, 1:30 and 2d 4h into one duration read back in words, catches 1.50 typed for 1 h 50 min, and asks whether 1:30 is h:mm or m:ss when the limits can't decide.

items.name: billing-period-input
items.title: Billing Period Input
items.description: Reads a recurring price back per period (₹499/month = ₹5,988/year) and, against a reference price, catches a yearly price in the monthly field, a team total entered per seat and other implausible jumps, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: replace-preview
items.title: Replace Preview
items.description: Find-and-replace that previews every match in context with a count, names matches inside longer words with a one-tap whole-word fix, preserves case, lets you skip single matches, and undoes the replace.

items.name: shift-time-input
items.title: Shift Time Input
items.description: Shift time input that treats 22:00–06:00 as an 8 h overnight shift, asks whether 9:00–5:00 meant 5 PM, questions 0 h, over-long and 26:00-style entries, deducts breaks (catching one typed in hours) and counts real hours across a DST change.

items.name: dimension-input
items.title: Dimension Input
items.description: Labels each side, fills all three from a pasted "16 x 12 x 8 in", checks them against what is being measured to catch the wrong unit, an extra digit and sides in the wrong order, and reads the size back in metric and imperial with volume and volumetric weight.

items.name: tax-inclusive-input
items.title: Tax-Inclusive Input
items.description: Price field with an explicit includes/excludes-tax toggle, a net + tax = gross readback, and flags for an "excludes" price that divides back to a round number, a mode switch that silently changed the total, and a typo'd rate like 0.18 or 180.

items.name: version-bump
items.title: Version Bump
items.description: Release picker that reads changes (Conventional Commits or tagged), marks the bump they need, previews each option's version, warns when the pick is too small (or a needless major), and reads back "1.4.2 → 2.0.0", handling 0.x, pre-release tags and their ordering.

items.name: dose-input
items.title: Dose Input
items.description: Flags ISMP error-prone dose designations as typed (trailing zeros, missing leading zero, U and IU, µg, cc, a unit flush against the number, uncommaed large numbers), rewrites the dose safely, offers the likely value when 10× outside the usual range and spells it back.

items.name: leftover-text-check
items.title: Leftover Text Check
items.description: Text check that flags chatbot chatter and refusals, unfilled placeholders ([product], XX%), TK and TODO markers and paragraphs pasted twice, without false alarms on [1], [sic] or Markdown links, and asks twice before publishing with leftovers.

items.name: ai-citation-check
items.title: AI Citation Check
items.description: Flags tells of made-up references (DOI prefix not matching the journal, a dash in a DOI, impossible years, leftover oaicite or 【4†source】 markers, unattributed quotes), looks DOIs, cases and links up via a pluggable verify, and marks anything unconfirmed Unverified.

items.name: k8s-resource-input
items.title: K8s Resource Input
items.description: Requests/limits fields that read values in plain units and catch CPU 500 meaning 500 cores, 400m memory meaning 0.4 bytes, unit-case slips, a limit under its request, CPU finer than 1m and requests above any node, with fixes, the QoS class and resources: paste.

items.name: connection-string-input
items.title: Connection String Input
items.description: Masks the password when not editing, reads back user, host, database and TLS mode, and catches unencoded @ # / % in passwords, localhost in production, missing or weak sslmode, unknown libpq parameters, wrong-database ports, Redis/MongoDB without TLS and .env quoting.

items.name: package-name-check
items.title: Package Name Check
items.description: npm and pip install-command check that flags lookalikes of popular packages (loadsh, crossenv, jeIlyfish), import names that aren't the package (sklearn, cv2, bs4, PIL), built-ins from the registry, unpublishable names, and via lookup, missing or brand-new names.

items.name: cache-control-input
items.title: Cache Control Input
items.description: Reads back who stores the response and for how long (browser, CDN via CDN-Cache-Control or Surrogate-Control, other shared caches) and flags per-user pages a CDN can cache, public cookie-setting responses, no-cache mistaken for no-store, unsafe immutable and missing Vary.

items.name: mrz-paste-input
items.title: MRZ Paste Input
items.description: Passport MRZ field (ICAO 9303 TD3) that validates each check digit and the composite, catches OCR slips like O for 0 and K for <, swapped lines, CRLF and stray spaces, proposes the likeliest fix for a bad digit, flags expired or soon-expiring passports, then fills the fields.

items.name: curl-pipe-guard
items.title: Curl Pipe Guard
items.description: Before a curl | sh (or wget, or iwr | iex) one-liner is copied or run, shows the script's real host and flags plain http, raw IPs, shortened links, a host off the product's docs domain, sudo, -k/--insecure and missing checksum or -f; offers safer step-by-step commands.

items.name: port-expose-guard
items.title: Port Expose Guard
items.description: Port mapping check for docker run, compose and Kubernetes Services that says who can reach each port and flags databases on 0.0.0.0 (which Docker opens ahead of ufw), host networking, -P, NodePort or public LoadBalancers, wrong container ports and unquoted 22:22 YAML, with fixes.

items.name: photo-spec-check
items.title: Photo Spec Check
items.description: Photo upload check against portal presets (UPSC, SSC, NTA, NEET, US visa) or your spec: real file type, KB, pixels, shape, print size, over-compression, face size and centring, background and colour, with a canvas fix that crops, resizes and re-encodes.

items.name: doc-upload-match
items.title: Doc Upload Match
items.description: Checks a file against the document asked for (Aadhaar back instead of front, Aadhaar in the PAN slot, a password-locked e-Aadhaar PDF, a multi-page PDF, a tiny, blurry or HEIC photo, a screenshot of a screenshot) using in-browser signals plus an optional classify hook.

items.name: ssh-key-input
items.title: SSH Key Input
items.description: Public-key field that flags a pasted private key loudly (rotate it; extract the public half in one tap), catches DSA and short RSA keys, wrapped or cut-off keys, wrong type prefixes, SSH2 export format and duplicates, and shows the SHA256 fingerprint as ssh-keygen does.

items.name: jwt-inspect
items.title: JWT Inspect
items.description: Local JWT decoder that never sends the token anywhere and flags alg none, HS vs RS key confusion, an expired token or future nbf (in the reader's zone), millisecond timestamps, a missing aud or iss, very long lifetimes, and secrets or personal data readable in the payload.

items.name: cert-paste-check
items.title: Cert Paste Check
items.description: Identifies certificates, private keys and CSRs in a paste and catches a chain out of order or missing its intermediate, expired or expiring certificates, a hostname the SANs don't cover, self-signed certificates in production and a non-matching key.

items.name: chmod-input
items.title: Chmod Input
items.description: Reads any mode (644, 0755, u+x, -rwxr-xr-x) back as rwx and plain words, and flags world-writable files, setuid/setgid, keys and .env files others can read, a writable ~/.ssh or authorized_keys, execute bits on data, 775 typed for 755 and short or decimal modes.

items.name: redirect-uri-input
items.title: Redirect URI Input
items.description: Checks a redirect URI the way an OAuth server does (exact string match), highlighting a differing trailing slash, scheme, case, www or port against the registered list with a one-tap swap, plus localhost in production, wildcards, fragments and stray whitespace.

items.name: csp-input
items.title: CSP Input
items.description: Flags 'unsafe-inline' without a nonce, 'unsafe-eval', * / data: / https: in script-src, missing default-src, object-src or base-uri, unquoted keywords, a stray comma that splits the policy, JSONP-hosting allowlisted hosts, typos and report-only traps.

items.name: public-env-guard
items.title: Public Env Guard
items.description: .env check that lists every NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, REACT_APP_, EXPO_PUBLIC_ or PUBLIC_ variable reaching the browser and flags secret key shapes, Supabase service_role JWTs, passwords in URLs, secret names and high-entropy values, with a server-only rename.

items.name: robots-txt-guard
items.title: Robots.txt Guard
items.description: robots.txt checker that flags Disallow: / for production, staging leftovers, rules blocking CSS/JS Google renders with, relative or wrong-host sitemaps, typos and fields Google ignores, with one-tap fixes and a URL tester naming the deciding line.

items.name: image-tag-input
items.title: Image Tag Input
items.description: Image reference field showing the implied docker.io/library/ and :latest, flags :latest or no tag in production, moving tags, typo'd or frozen registries, private images that fall back to Docker Hub, malformed digests and arch-specific tags, with fixes such as pinning a digest.

items.name: column-mapper
items.title: Column Mapper
items.description: Checks a column mapping against sample values: emails in the phone column, first and last names swapped, DD/MM read as MM/DD (with a readback of what a date becomes), the same field mapped twice and required fields left unmapped, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: boolean-query-input
items.title: Boolean Query Input
items.description: Shows how the engine groups AND and OR (implied brackets highlighted) and offers the grouping you meant; catches unclosed quotes and brackets, curly quotes, [ ] used as brackets, lowercase and/or and dangling operators, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: cors-origin-input
items.title: CORS Origin Input
items.description: Catches * with credentials, null, trailing slashes or paths, missing schemes, default ports and http or localhost in production, with one-tap fixes and a tester that names the near miss blocking an origin.

items.name: webhook-url-input
items.title: Webhook URL Input
items.description: Webhook URL field that judges the URL for its environment (ngrok, tunnel, localhost or private IP is an error in production, a hint in test), flags staging hosts, plain http and missing paths, and diffs against the last saved URL to catch www or trailing-slash-only changes.

items.name: list-paste
items.title: List Paste
items.description: Paste box that splits on lines, commas, semicolons and tabs (keeping "Shah, Priya" <…> whole), counts valid, duplicate and invalid items with the line and reason for each, and removes the bad ones in one undoable tap. Validator is pluggable.

items.name: env-paste
items.title: Env Paste
items.description: Catches .env slips loaders accept silently (stray or curly quotes, padded values, a ' #' that cuts a value short, duplicate keys, bad key names, empty values, test keys in production) by showing a parsed table of what the app will read, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: json-field
items.title: JSON Field
items.description: JSON text field that validates as you type, shows a caret at the exact line and column, and repairs trailing commas, single or smart quotes, unquoted keys, comments, Python literals (True/None), missing commas and unclosed braces with a token-aware fix. Includes Format.

items.name: regex-field
items.title: Regex Field
items.description: Regex input with static checks (unescaped dot, missing ^…$, greedy .*, nested quantifiers like (a+)+), plain-English hints, one-tap fixes, and live test strings matched in a time-capped Web Worker so a runaway pattern can't freeze the page.

items.name: cidr-input
items.title: CIDR Input
items.description: Reads an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR back as its exact range and address count, catches host bits set (offering both the network and single-host readings), and warns on 0.0.0.0/0, a missing prefix, leading zeros and overlaps with existing ranges.

items.name: version-range-input
items.title: Version Range Input
items.description: npm-style semver range input that reads ranges back in plain English, marks which published versions match and which installs, and warns about ^0.x lock-in, a hyphen without spaces, commas used for AND and ranges that match nothing.

items.name: glob-input
items.title: Glob Input
items.description: Glob field that matches the pattern live against the files you pass, flags no-match and match-everything patterns, the * vs ** mix-up that skips subfolders, ** glued to a name, ./ and backslashes, with one-tap fixes. Dependency-free matcher with {a,b} expansion.

items.name: i18n-string-field
items.title: i18n String Field
items.description: Translation field that compares the text with its source: dropped or renamed placeholders ({count}, %s, {{name}}, …), unclosed tags, ICU plural forms the target language needs per CLDR, rendered length against a UI budget, and untranslated pastes. One-tap fixes.

items.name: sql-guard
items.title: SQL Guard
items.description: SQL box with a small tokenizer (comments and strings ignored) that flags UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, a commented-out WHERE, always-true conditions, DROP and TRUNCATE, asks before writes on production, shows estimated rows and requires typing the table name.

items.name: markdown-check
items.title: Markdown Check
items.description: Markdown field that catches unclosed ** or backticks, [text] (url) with a space, empty or space-broken links, #Title with no space and raw HTML the sanitizer strips, previews each spot as it will render, and offers a one-tap fix.

items.name: yaml-field
items.title: YAML Field
items.description: YAML editor that flags values that load without error but change meaning (NO/yes/on/off as booleans, 1.10 as 1.1, 0755 as octal, 22:22 as base-60), duplicate keys, tabs and misaligned indentation, with line, column, the parsed value and one-tap fixes.

items.name: webhook-test
items.title: Webhook Test
items.description: Webhook URL field that flags localhost and private IPs, plain http, a missing path and tunnel URLs, then judges a test delivery like the sender: redirects fail (one-tap switch to the final URL), slow replies near the timeout and 200 login pages are caught.

items.name: utm-check
items.title: UTM Check
items.description: UTM link checker that catches mixed case and spaces, source and medium swapped, a medium GA4's default channel rules file as organic or Unassigned, misspelled keys, a second "?", tags after "#" and tags on internal links, and reads back the GA4 channel.

items.name: reorder-readback
items.title: Reorder Readback
items.description: Sortable list that announces each move with its meaning ("Moved Razorpay from 3rd to 1st. It's now tried first.") and Undo. Drags only from the grip, refuses to displace pinned rows, marks rows moved since save, and offers click, arrow and keyboard moves.

items.name: nominee-check
items.title: Nominee Check
items.description: Nomination form check for bank deposits, lockers and demat/MF holdings: shares not adding to 100%, nominees past the limit (4 bank, 3 demat), splits on a locker, missing relationship or minor's date of birth, minors with no adult, duplicates and no nominee, with a plain readback.

items.name: passport-validity-check
items.title: Passport Validity Check
items.description: Passport check against the destination's rule (6 months, Schengen's 3 months after leaving and 10 years since issue, blank pages) that names the exact date it must last until and offers the latest return that would pass. Default rules carry sources and can be replaced.

items.name: seat-gap-check
items.title: Seat Gap Check
items.description: Seat-map check for group bookings: a party split across the row, a single empty seat left behind (which many venues refuse) and a child seated away from every adult, with problem seats marked and a one-tap move to the nearest block that fits.

items.name: formula-overwrite-guard
items.title: Formula Overwrite Guard
items.description: Previews in place which cells a paste would change and how, leaves out a heading row the copy dragged along, and offers to paste values only into empty and non-formula cells; safe pastes go straight in with Undo.

items.name: passkey-name-prompt
items.title: Passkey Name Prompt
items.description: Post-creation passkey naming prompt that prefills a distinct name from the AAGUID (iCloud Keychain, 1Password) or the device ("Mac · Chrome", phone, security key), numbers it when taken, blocks empty and duplicate names, nudges away from generic ones, and says whether it syncs.

items.name: irreversible-diff-badge
items.title: Irreversible Diff Badge
items.description: Chip for permanent fields that turns amber once edited, plus a pre-save readback listing only the permanent fields that changed (from → to) with consequences and one-tap Revert, behind a confirmation that resets whenever that list changes.

items.name: stale-attachment-check
items.title: Stale Attachment Check
items.description: Attachment check against nearby files: a newer save of the same document, names saying draft, old, copy or (1), Office lock files and files dated before the subject's date, with a one-tap swap to the newer file and Undo.

items.name: dependency-license-check
items.title: Dependency License Check
items.description: Reads each SPDX expression against your policy (GPL or AGPL in closed source, no or unknown license, source-available terms in a hosted product, deny lists) and catches relicenses between versions with a one-tap "Stay on" the last version under the old license.

items.name: heading-outline
items.title: Heading Outline
items.description: Live heading outline for a Markdown draft or DOM region. Flags skipped levels (shown as dashed ghost rows), extra or missing H1s, empty headings, bold text posing as a heading and overlong headings, with a one-tap level fix and rows that jump to the heading.

items.name: link-text-check
items.title: Link Text Check
items.description: Link text check for Markdown or a live DOM region that flags "click here" and "read more", URLs as link text, empty links and the same text pointing to different places, with a rewrite that lifts the sentence's own words into the link and a view of the links list as read out.

items.name: reading-level
items.title: Reading Level
items.description: Live Flesch-Kincaid grade against a target. Tints the hardest sentences in place (only when long and dense), with the reason and a jump to each, and offers one-tap plain-word swaps ("utilize" → "use").

items.name: backup-codes
items.title: Backup Codes
items.description: Continue unlocks only after the codes are downloaded, printed or copied (or all three with require="all"); then one code must be typed back, with paste refused and look-alike characters forgiven, to show the saved copy is readable.

items.name: recovery-check
items.title: Recovery Check
items.description: Account-recovery checkup. Flags recovery email or phone not confirmed in months, no backup method, a password-only account, one phone acting as both second factor and recovery, and low backup codes, each with a fix callback.

items.name: unsaved-changes-bar
items.title: Unsaved Changes Bar
items.description: Unsaved-changes bar that names every dirty field (with per-field revert), guards the tab close, saves on Ctrl/⌘+S and asks twice before Discard; editing a field back to its saved value makes it clean again.

items.name: save-status
items.title: Save Status
items.description: Autosave status with an aging "Saved · 2 min ago", an honest offline state and Retry on error, plus a debounced useAutosave hook that runs one save at a time and always saves the newest value last.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error Summary
items.description: A summary that takes focus on submit, links each error to its field, and ticks items off live as they are fixed, plus a useFormErrors() hook.

items.name: form-progress
items.title: Form Progress
items.description: Watches a form and counts the required fields still empty or invalid, with a Next missing button that moves focus to the next one.

items.name: preflight-checklist
items.title: Preflight Checklist
items.description: Checklist that locks an action until auto and manual checks pass, names the blockers, resets manual ticks and re-runs checks when the revision changes, and re-verifies right before the action runs.

items.name: attachment-nudge
items.title: Attachment Nudge
items.description: Spots attachment phrases in English, Hindi and Hinglish ("PFA", "attach kar diya"), ignoring quoted replies, negations, future mentions and shared cloud links, and asks inline to Attach or Send anyway.

items.name: file-guard
items.title: File Guard
items.description: Checks size, type, count, empty files and duplicates, and reads each file's first bytes to catch a renamed extension, with a one-tap rename fix.

items.name: draft-restore
items.title: Draft Restore
items.description: Autosaves to localStorage and, on reopen, offers the draft with a field-by-field preview that keeps any value the server changed since, unless you tick it. Drafts expire after 7 days by default.

items.name: tab-collision
items.title: Tab Collision
items.description: Single-editor lock across tabs: one tab edits (BroadcastChannel, with a localStorage storage-event fallback), the others become read-only until someone picks "Use this tab", with a confirm when the other tab has unsaved changes.

items.name: review-step
items.title: Review Step
items.description: Review page for wizards: every answer by step with named Edit links, empty optional fields and values changed since last time flagged, missing required answers blocking submit, and one deliberate submit that ignores carried-over clicks and disables while pending.

items.name: dependent-reset
items.title: Dependent Reset
items.description: A hook clears only what a parent change made invalid (pruning just the add-ons a new plan lacks), and a notice names each lost value, highlights those fields and offers Undo.

items.name: version-scrubber
items.title: Version Scrubber
items.description: Version timeline with the current version pinned, a word diff of exactly what a restore would change, and a second confirm step that counts words lost and gained and names changed numbers.

items.name: autofill-check
items.title: Autofill Check
items.description: Detects autofill (the :autofill animationstart hook plus a no-typing batch heuristic), outlines and lists filled fields for review, flags an email in Name or a value that differs from the account with a one-tap fix, and holds the first submit.

items.name: field-history
items.title: Field History
items.description: A trigger beside the label flags a recent change by someone else and opens "Was ₹500 until Priya changed it yesterday" with a one-tap revert of that field alone, says what the revert replaces (including your unsaved edit) and lets you undo it.

items.name: terms-changes
items.title: Terms Changes
items.description: Terms re-acceptance with a summary and exact word diff since the accepted version, changed numbers called out, Accept locked until every change has stayed on screen long enough to read (an early tap jumps to the next unread one), and a consent record with both versions.

items.name: hidden-field-guard
items.title: Hidden Field Guard
items.description: Banner for a hidden conditional section that names the fields still holding values and says whether they will be submitted or dropped, with Keep, Clear (through real input events so React state follows) and Undo.

items.name: upload-wait
items.title: Upload Wait
items.description: Submit button for forms with uploads: pressing submit mid-upload validates and queues the send, the button fills with combined progress ("Waiting for 2 uploads…"), it submits by itself when they finish, a failed upload pauses it until retried, and leaving asks first.

items.name: consent-group
items.title: Consent Group
items.description: Boxes are never pre-ticked, required terms sit apart from optional purposes, Accept all spells out what it will tick first, one sentence reads back the choice, and each change produces a record with time, method, text version and a fingerprint of the wording.

items.name: dob-input
items.title: DOB Input
items.description: Reads the date and age back as you type and catches this year typed by habit (age 0), future dates, implausible ages, a day typed into the month box, pasted dates that read two ways and under-age sign-ups, with a fix and the date someone becomes eligible.

items.name: recurrence-scope
items.title: Recurrence Scope
items.description: This one / This and following / All picker for recurring events that reads back the dates each choice changes, with counts and past dates called out, and warns by date and field before overwriting occurrences that were edited on their own.

items.name: tree-select-readback
items.title: Tree Select Readback
items.description: Nested checkbox tree that reads the choice back in plain words ("All of Marketing except Paid ads; 3 of 12 in Sales"), tells a whole-group tick apart from ticking every item, and warns that a whole-group tick includes items added later, with a one-tap pin to today's items.

items.name: repeat-rows
items.title: Repeat Rows
items.description: Add-another rows (line items, guests) with min and max limits, Undo after a remove, duplicate rows flagged with a one-tap remove, blank rows called out before submit, Enter that adds a row instead of submitting, and focus that lands on the right field.

items.name: step-invalidation
items.title: Step Invalidation
items.description: Wizard helper that says exactly what a change to an earlier answer clears ("Changing plan to Basic clears Region on step 3…") before applying it, marks affected steps, reviews only them and holds Finish until they're checked; changing back restores what was removed.

items.name: import-preview
items.title: Import Preview
items.description: Import preview that finds the real heading row, maps columns by heading and by values with a confidence, holds the import while a required field is unmapped, and lists every skipped line with its line number and reason before a plain "Import 412 · skip 7".

items.name: crop-guard
items.title: Crop Guard
items.description: Checks pluggable face and text boxes against the crop, the profile circle and Story safe zones, offers a one-tap fit that moves the crop as little as possible, and previews it at the small size people actually see.

items.name: stay-length
items.title: Stay Length
items.description: Date range readback ("Mon 2 Nov – Sun 8 Nov · 6 nights, 7 days") that flags an end before the start, nights confused with days, a check-out that may really be the last night, and weekends or holidays that change how much leave it costs, each with a one-tap fix.

items.name: event-overlap
items.title: Event Overlap
items.description: Lists clashes (overlaps, back-to-back with no break, too little travel time between places, busy all-day events, other-zone events in their own time) on a small timeline, and moves the event to the nearest slot that keeps your buffer and travel time, with Undo.

items.name: unanswered-check
items.title: Unanswered Check
items.description: Pre-submit check for tests and surveys: required and optional blanks, partly answered and flagged questions as numbered jump links, time left and per-question pace, a second click for blanks, a hard stop for required survey questions and a submit that waits for saves.

items.name: cutoff-picker
items.title: Cutoff Picker
items.description: Counts down to the cutoff in store time with the shopper's time beside it, names skipped holidays and closed days, says when the store's date differs, and never moves a chosen date silently: a passed cutoff is announced with the new earliest date one tap away.

items.name: trip-date-chain
items.title: Trip Date Chain
items.description: Night-by-night strip of stays under flights that catches a small-hours landing with the room booked from that date, nights paid before a +1 arrival, gap nights, double-booked nights and a room kept past a small-hours departure, with one-tap fixes and Undo.

items.name: meeting-time-spread
items.title: Meeting Time Spread
items.description: Meeting time slider with each attendee's day underneath (night, before or after work, weekend, day ahead or behind, DST weeks via the tz database) that suggests the kindest slot: nobody at night, then fewest out of hours, then rotating away from recent sufferers.

items.name: bnpl-schedule-check
items.title: BNPL Schedule Check
items.description: Draws each payment on a calendar beside other plans and paydays, flags a card that expires before a payment, payments just before payday and plans stacking in one week, offers one-tap fixes, shows the late fee in money and asks for a second press while the card problem stands.

items.name: transit-visa-check
items.title: Transit Visa Check
items.description: Layover check against starter airport transit visa lists (UK, Germany, France, Netherlands; US has no airside transit) and border-entry traps (self-transfer, onward Schengen flight, UK to Ireland, leaving the airport), with exempting documents and official links.

items.name: llm-cost-estimate
items.title: LLM Cost Estimate
items.description: Pre-run cost panel that estimates input/output tokens and cost from your dated price table, shows the worst case without max_tokens, catches context-window overflows, runs far bigger than the last and premium models on bulk jobs, and shows Batch API savings.

items.name: kube-context-guard
items.title: Kube Context Guard
items.description: kubectl/helm field that shows the context, cluster and namespace a command will really use, flags production, the default namespace, a manifest namespace that disagrees with -n and a switched context, and asks for the context name before production changes.

items.name: security-event-log
items.title: Security Event Log
items.description: Security activity log that highlights risky changes from other devices, groups a burst (new device, 2-step off, new recovery email) as a likely takeover, and offers "This wasn't me" with each remedy as an untickable checkbox. Times follow the account's zone.

items.name: dst-shift-notice
items.title: DST Shift Notice
items.description: Lists each attendee's affected dates with the new local time when daylight saving changes on different dates (US and EU weeks apart, India never), flags moves outside working hours, and offers to fix the series to the organiser's zone or UTC with a count of who moves.

items.name: environment-badge
items.title: Environment Badge
items.description: Marks the page, tab title (kept through navigation) and favicon with PRODUCTION, STAGING or DEV (production hatched in red), reads names like "eu-prod-2" word by word, never calls an unknown environment safe, and includes a hook that asks for confirmation only in production.

items.name: acting-as-banner
items.title: Acting As Banner
items.description: Shows a sticky "You're acting as…" bar with who is really signed in, a countdown to when impersonation ends and a switch-back action, plus an org chip that makes each destructive button say where it acts.

items.name: offline-banner
items.title: Offline Banner
items.description: Connection banner that counts queued changes while offline, stays up after reconnecting until the queue has actually synced, offers Retry if the sync fails, and can warn before leaving with unsynced changes.

items.name: stale-data-notice
items.title: Stale Data Notice
items.description: Banner that appears when a tab comes back after a while (default 5 min away) or the data passes its max age (default 10 min), says how old it is and why that matters, and offers a one-tap refresh.

items.name: conflict-banner
items.title: Conflict Banner
items.description: Names who changed the record and when, shows a word diff, and before "Keep mine" confirms how many of their words it would replace, until you've compared.

items.name: session-timeout
items.title: Session Timeout
items.description: Idle-timeout warning dialog with a countdown and a draining ring that turns red in the last 10 seconds, a Stay signed in action that extends the session through your callback, cross-tab activity sync and calm screen-reader announcements.

items.name: do-not-close
items.title: Do Not Close
items.description: Adds a close warning and a marked tab title while work runs, shows a rolling-rate time-left estimate, says "Safe to close" when done and offers Retry when it fails.

items.name: timezone-mismatch
items.title: Timezone Mismatch
items.description: Banner shown when the device zone differs from the account zone: both clocks side by side, a one-time choice to use the device zone, a confirmation that keeps focus, remembered per pair of zones, comparing real clock changes so briefly drifting zones still count.

items.name: update-available
items.title: Update Available
items.description: New-deploy banner that polls a version endpoint (or takes a prop), explains what a refresh does, never refreshes while there are unsaved changes (offering "Refresh after I save"), and lets "Later" skip only that build.

items.name: revision-banner
items.title: Revision Banner
items.description: Banner for viewing an old revision: the content sits in a read-only striped frame that explains blocked edits, and "Restore this version" confirms which latest version it replaces and how many words change.

items.name: filter-notice
items.title: Filter Notice
items.description: Says how many items active filters hide, shows each filter as a removable chip with how many items it hides on its own, and warns when selected items are hidden.

items.name: disabled-reason
items.title: Disabled Reason
items.description: Keeps the control focusable with aria-disabled and explains on hover, focus or tap what blocks it, in a portalled panel no toolbar can clip, with a jump to each fix, a shake when a blocked press lands and cleared blockers sliding away.

items.name: quota-forecast
items.title: Quota Forecast
items.description: Usage meter that projects the current rate to the reset ("At this pace you'll run out Thu 22 Oct"), turns amber or red on that forecast rather than on raw usage, marks the even-pace point, and says what happens at the limit.

items.name: resume-marker
items.title: Resume Marker
items.description: Saves the item a reader rested on (after a short delay) to localStorage, marks it "You were here" on return, and offers a jump there and back instead of scrolling the page by itself.

items.name: new-content-pill
items.title: New Content Pill
items.description: Live feed wrapper that holds new arrivals behind a "5 new posts" pill that inserts and scrolls up on tap, inserting directly only when the reader is at the top and not mid-press. Works in its own scroll box or with scrollTarget="window".

items.name: presence-lock
items.title: Presence Lock
items.description: Presence UI that shows who is editing what ("Priya is editing Price"), softly locks that field in their colour with an "Edit anyway" that warns once, never locks someone already typing, and releases locks held by idle people. Transport-agnostic.

items.name: unsent-marker
items.title: Unsent Marker
items.description: Left-behind draft shown as a dashed "Not sent · Priya hasn't received it" bubble in the thread where the reply would be, with Send, Edit and a two-tap Discard, plus a "Not sent:" preview for conversation lists.

items.name: presenter-mode
items.title: Presenter Mode
items.description: Presenting mode where values wrapped in <Sensitive> are removed from the page (not blurred) behind fixed-length masks, a visible bar shows the mode is on, a deliberate hold peeks one value, and starting a screen share in this tab suggests turning it on.

items.name: locale-notice
items.title: Locale Notice
items.description: Shows a value as you write it and as the reader's locale writes it, says what they would take it to mean ("In Germany, 1,000 reads as 1"), offers a form neither side can flip, and catches numbers typed with the other convention's decimal mark ("1,5" becoming 15).

items.name: progress-heartbeat
items.title: Progress Heartbeat
items.description: Progress bar that separates working from stalled (no heartbeat for N seconds: "No progress for 40s" with Retry), alive-but-not-advancing from silence, shows a time-left range that widens instead of a jumpy countdown, and holds at 99% until the job reports done.

items.name: account-switch-guard
items.title: Account Switch Guard
items.description: When several accounts are signed in, names who the action runs as and who it is not ("Posting as Acme Corp, not Tushar"), and catches a switch made in another tab so the button names the page's account instead of silently acting as the new one.

items.name: maintenance-window
items.title: Maintenance Window
items.description: Banner for planned downtime in the reader's time zone with a countdown that sharpens as it nears, a start button that warns when a long job would run into the window, and, during the window, a notice to keep unsaved edits plus a reload warning.

items.name: permission-pre-ask
items.title: Permission Pre-Ask
items.description: In-page pre-ask for browser permissions that explains why before calling the real API, tells a closed prompt from a block, shows this browser's exact re-enable steps, and flips to on by itself once the user allows it.

items.name: clock-skew
items.title: Clock Skew
items.description: Compares the device clock with server time (Date header or prop), says by how much and what breaks (authenticator codes, "expires in" timers, secure sites), corrects the countdowns inside it, and clears the warning once the clock is fixed.

items.name: private-mode-notice
items.title: Private Mode Notice
items.description: Notice for private windows, blocked site data or a full quota, based on a real write test before any guess, that offers to export unsaved work and can warn before the tab closes.

items.name: experimental-badge
items.title: Experimental Badge
items.description: The badge opens a plain list of concrete risks (work may be lost, things may change or disappear), a feedback link and a one-tap switch back to the stable version that says what happens to their work.

items.name: retry-after
items.title: Retry After
items.description: Action button that, on 429/503, reads Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date) and RateLimit headers, explains which limit was hit and when it resets, counts down, ignores impatient clicks and retries automatically with jitter while the user's input stays put.

items.name: low-battery-guard
items.title: Low Battery Guard
items.description: Pre-task banner that compares battery runway (to a safety reserve, from the Battery Status API or a measured drain rate) with the task's length, shows where the battery would cut it off, and offers "Start when plugged in". Stays silent when the task will finish anyway.

items.name: data-cost-notice
items.title: Data Cost Notice
items.description: On Data Saver, mobile data or a slow connection (Network Information API, or a Save-Data hint you pass) shows the size and an honest rough time, offers a lighter version with what it saves, or waits for Wi-Fi and then starts by itself.

items.name: sunset-notice
items.title: Sunset Notice
items.description: Reads Sunset (RFC 8594) and Deprecation (RFC 9745) headers and their Link relations, lists what stops working, shows when in the reader's zone (flagging a different day than the UTC date), turns amber then red, and snoozes only until the next 30/7/1-day mark.

items.name: print-guard
items.title: Print Guard
items.description: Pre-print check that finds light-on-dark text the browser drops, collapsed sections, tables wider than the page, scroll boxes that print only what's visible and links without addresses, with print-only fixes; since Ctrl+P can't be stopped, autoFix applies them too.

items.name: bcc-guard
items.title: Bcc Guard
items.description: Previews the To line as one recipient sees it, counts the names, private addresses and companies exposed, flags lists where membership is itself sensitive ("HIV", "arrears"), moves outside recipients to Bcc in one tap with Undo, and asks for a second press to send.

items.name: hidden-content-check
items.title: Hidden Content Check
items.description: Pre-share check for Office files that reads the file locally with no dependencies and lists hidden and very hidden sheets, hidden rows and columns, tracked deletions, hidden text, comments, speaker notes, hidden slides, embedded workbooks, internal-drive links and author details.

items.name: prompt-data-guard
items.title: Prompt Data Guard
items.description: AI chat composer guard that says before send what goes where ("248 customer rows and a CONFIDENTIAL doc will go to OpenAI"), counting table rows, name columns, emails, phones, cards, Aadhaar, PAN and API keys in text and attachments, and can send with stand-ins.

items.name: bill-split-check
items.title: Bill Split Check
