items.description: Checks an item-by-item split against the receipt and catches unclaimed items, tax counted twice, a tip on top of a service charge, a total that doesn't match and what an equal split costs the lightest eater, each with a fix and Undo. Shares are rounded so they always add up.

items.name: callback-number-check
items.title: Callback Number Check
items.description: Reads a callback number's country and line type with libphonenumber and flags +1 Caribbean codes posing as US area codes, one-ring calls from abroad, premium-rate and shared-cost lines, foreign toll-free, unassigned ranges and 'bank' numbers missing from its list.

items.name: quote-lock
items.title: Quote Lock
items.description: Held-quote panel that drains as the hold ends, fetches a fresh quote (skew-safe with validFor), rolls old to new with the difference called out, turns a worse-than-tolerance price into an explicit Accept, re-quotes a late Pay, and ignores stale responses and double presses.

items.name: calendar-external-guest-guard
items.title: Calendar External Guest Guard
items.description: Names guests outside your domains (and a colleague's personal Gmail used for their work address), then lists what they get under Google Calendar defaults: internal agenda lines, file names, open-link files, the guest list, edit rights. Fixes, Undo, second press to send.

items.name: chat-audience-check
items.title: Chat Audience Check
items.description: Flags members whose name differs from how you saved them, unidentifiable names, people who joined after your last message and outsiders. Quiet for ordinary messages; for sensitive text it lists them with Remove, View profile and "I know them" and needs a second press.

items.name: out-of-office-check
items.title: Out of Office Check
items.description: Auto-reply check for Gmail or Outlook that reads back when replies go out and who gets which text, compares dates with the return date in the message, and flags replying on your return day, stopping early, no end date, last time's date, and outside replies that overshare.

items.name: retract-window
items.title: Retract Window
items.description: Under a sent message: how long Edit and Unsend stay open on that platform (iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack presets or your own), a draining bar, who already read it and whose app keeps the original, Delete for me kept apart, and a correction once windows close.

items.name: card-bill-pay
items.title: Card Bill Pay
items.description: Before Pay, explains what the amount does: anything short of the total loses the interest-free period on the whole bill and on new spends, the minimum is turned into years and interest, and below the minimum or past the 3-day grace it shows the late fee and credit-bureau report.

items.name: otp-share-guard
items.title: OTP Share Guard
items.description: OTP display that says what the code approves ("approves a ₹24,999 payment to Croma") and, during a call or screen share or when it isn't what the user started, shows a never-share warning with hold-to-reveal, delayed Copy, a code hidden while sharing and "Not me".

items.name: bank-transfer-timing
items.title: Bank Transfer Timing
items.description: Reads back when money arrives on the chosen rail (IMPS/UPI instantly, the next half-hourly NEFT batch plus up to 2 hours, RTGS within 30 minutes) and catches RTGS under ₹2 lakh, IMPS over ₹5 lakh, UPI over its category cap, bank limits and new-payee caps.

items.name: gift-card-scam-guard
items.title: Gift Card Scam Guard
items.description: Gift card checkout check. Spots scam patterns (large total, several cards, notes about a boss, tax, police, refunds or tech support, sending codes, a first order), says no real company takes gift-card payment, and asks one question; "someone asked me to" ends at a stop screen.

items.name: commit-secret-guard
items.title: Commit Secret Guard
items.description: Scans only added diff lines for provider keys, private keys, passwords in URLs, hard-coded secrets and high-entropy strings, flags .env and key files, skips test fixtures by pattern (except live key formats), and offers per-finding fixes, warning to rotate if already pushed.

items.name: publish-preview
items.title: Publish Preview
items.description: npm publish preview from `npm pack --dry-run --json` that flags .env files and keys, source maps, tests, repo config, large files, entry points missing from the build, an already-published version, private: true and no files allowlist, with fixes.

items.name: upi-autopay-review
items.title: UPI AutoPay Review
items.description: Pre-approval review of a UPI AutoPay mandate: cap, schedule, validity and merchant read back against the plan, flagging a cap far above the price, "as presented" schedules, no end date, the wrong merchant and debits above the PIN-free limit, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: upi-collect-guard
items.title: UPI Collect Guard
items.description: Collect-request screen that states "You pay ₹4,999 to…", asks whether the user expects to receive money (a yes becomes a decline-only stop), and flags refund, prize, OLX-buyer and KYC wording, person-to-person collects, unknown requesters and small test amounts before the PIN.

items.name: tds-invoice-total
items.title: TDS Invoice Total
items.description: Invoice calculator for Indian freelancers: fee + GST − TDS = what reaches the bank, using the rate and section for the invoice date (s.393 of the 2025 Act; was 194J/194C) and yearly thresholds, flagging TDS on GST, the wrong rate and the no-PAN rate, with a note for the client.

items.name: link-access-check
items.title: Link Access Check
items.description: Pre-send check for Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Notion, Figma and Box links that names which recipients can't open each one, offers fixes (give view access, open to the company, ask the owner), and warns when an anyone-with-the-link doc goes outside your organisation.

items.name: reply-all-guard
items.title: Reply All Guard
items.description: Reply-all check: counts real reach with distribution lists expanded, names external recipients by domain, catches a BCC'd or forwarded-to reader about to reveal themselves and a Reply-To that points elsewhere, with sender-only or internal-only fixes and Undo.

items.name: duplicate-payment-guard
items.title: Duplicate Payment Guard
items.description: Swallows a double tap (charged once), after a timeout offers Check status before paying again because the first may still land, and for a deliberate repeat says "You paid Ravi ₹2,400 12 min ago" and needs a separate second press.

items.name: bulk-send-guard
items.title: Bulk Send Guard
items.description: Before a blast, states how many it reaches, how many opted out and are excluded, who is in quiet hours in their own time zone (held by default), the cost and any jump over the last send, then needs an explicit confirm, with the count typed when the jump is big.

items.name: pii-post-guard
items.title: PII Post Guard
items.description: Post composer guard that says who will see the post and finds phone numbers, emails, addresses, Aadhaar, PAN, card numbers and OTPs with real checks (Verhoeff, Luhn, PAN holder type, OTP keywords) rather than loose digit runs, masking one or all the way each format expects.

items.name: recurring-charge-readback
items.title: Recurring Charge Readback
items.description: Readback beside a subscribe button: charged today, when the first real charge and any intro price step-up land, and the cancel-by time with zone. Flags trials too short to cancel in time and button text that disagrees with the charge.

items.name: gst-invoice-check
items.title: GST Invoice Check
items.description: Compares the supplier GSTIN's state with the place of supply to pick CGST + SGST/UTGST or IGST (SEZ and exports always IGST), checks each rate against the slabs in force on the invoice date, LUT exports, the CGST/SGST split and the totals, with a one-tap fix.

items.name: role-preview
items.title: Role Preview
items.description: Role picker that shows exactly what the chosen role can and can't do, diffs it against the current role, and suggests the smallest role that keeps the needed abilities when the pick adds dangerous permissions.

items.name: visibility-picker
items.title: Visibility Picker
items.description: Sharing-level picker where narrowing is instant but widening (a riskier level or more people) shows who gains access and needs an explicit confirm, so a double-click or arrow key can't publish; policy-blocked levels say why, and a failed save restores the old level.

items.name: recipient-check
items.title: Recipient Check
items.description: Recipient field that marks external addresses in amber, catches typo'd and lookalike domains with a one-tap fix, blocks duplicates, spots a known name paired with someone else's address, and warns when a message goes to too many people.

items.name: secret-paste-guard
items.title: Secret Paste Guard
items.description: Wraps a text field and scans its value for known key formats (AWS, GitHub, Stripe, Slack, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, JWTs, private keys) plus long high-entropy strings, offering Redact (keeps the last 4) or Keep.

items.name: external-link
items.title: External Link
items.description: Confirms off-site links with the real ASCII destination and its registrable domain in bold, and flags punycode, lookalike domains, link text that disagrees with the href, buried brand names, raw IPs and plain http.

items.name: charge-summary
items.title: Charge Summary
items.description: Shows today's amount, the first charge and renewal dates, taxes (added or included) and one-time credits upfront, and sums it up in one plain sentence of what you'll pay.

items.name: send-time-check
items.title: Send Time Check
items.description: Send-time check that shows the recipient's local time on a strip of their day, flags night, after-hours, weekend (including Friday–Saturday weekends) and holidays you pass, and offers a one-tap schedule for the start of their next working day.

items.name: fill-before-copy
items.title: Fill Before Copy
items.description: Turns each placeholder (<YOUR_API_KEY>, {{project_id}}) into an inline field and blocks Copy, or asks once, until all of them are filled.

items.name: photo-location-guard
items.title: Photo Location Guard
items.description: Pre-upload photo check that reads EXIF and XMP (GPS with its precision, capture time, camera serial, owner name, a hidden uncropped preview) and offers "Remove location", which re-encodes the photo upright in the browser and re-checks the result.

items.name: currency-hint
items.title: Currency Hint
items.description: Shows a foreign price with a clearly approximate, dated conversion ("€49.00 ≈ ₹4,520"), prices a merchant's dynamic currency conversion against the reference rate with a switch back to local currency, estimates card fees and flags stale rates.

items.name: mention-guard
items.title: Mention Guard
items.description: Message box that says how many people @channel, @everyone or a group mention will notify and how many are in other time zones, flags mentioned people who aren't in the conversation, offers fixes, and turns Send into an explicit "Notify 1,240 people" confirm.

items.name: share-link
items.title: Share Link
items.description: Share-link settings read back as one sentence ("Anyone with the link can edit until Fri 16 Oct, 5:00 PM"), with warnings and fixes for public edit access and open-ended public links, a live expiry countdown, a flag when you widen a copied link, and confirm before revoke.

items.name: merge-field-check
items.title: Merge Field Check
items.description: Template editor for bulk email and SMS that renders the message per recipient and flags unknown fields (with typo suggestions), broken braces and recipients with no value (spaces count as empty), with one-tap fixes and fallbacks, and steps to the recipients who'd get a gap.

items.name: forward-guard
items.title: Forward Guard
items.description: Lists what new recipients will see for the first time (earlier messages, internal notes, attachments, other people's addresses), skips messages they were already on, trims internal notes by default and lets each item be dropped before sending.

items.name: payee-check
items.title: Payee Check
items.description: Payee form that asks your backend who holds the account and compares it with the typed name like Confirmation of Payee: match, close match with the real name one tap away, or no match with the name hidden and an explicit pay-anyway, plus first-payee and large-amount callouts.

items.name: csv-export-guard
items.title: CSV Export Guard
items.description: Previews how each column opens in a spreadsheet (phone numbers and PIN codes losing leading zeros or +, long IDs becoming 1.23457E+15, "3-4" turning into a date, cells starting with = + - @ running as formulas) and offers per-column fixes.

items.name: link-unfurl-check
items.title: Link Unfurl Check
items.description: Link field that previews the unfurl (title, description, image from your Open Graph fetch) and catches localhost and staging URLs, tracking parameters, redirects (hard when they land on a sign-in page) and missing or undersized images, with fixes.

items.name: qr-share
items.title: QR Share
items.description: QR code generator that reads the exact URL back under the code, re-decodes the matrix it drew to prove nothing was truncated, and warns about localhost, staging, http, invisible characters and dense codes, with one-tap fixes. Dependency-free encoder (byte mode, ECC M).

items.name: redact-image
items.title: Redact Image
items.description: Screenshot redactor with solid boxes only (blur and pixelation can be reversed), padded and snapped to whole pixels, placed by drag or keyboard, with suggestions from a pluggable text detector and a flattened, metadata-free PNG export that is re-read to check every box.

items.name: sms-segments
items.title: SMS Segments
items.description: SMS composer that splits text into the parts carriers bill (160/153 GSM-7, 70/67 UCS-2), names the curly quote or emoji that forced UCS-2 ("this ’ makes it 3 messages instead of 2"), fixes it in one tap, and reads the total back per recipient count.

items.name: export-scope
items.title: Export Scope
items.description: Reads back exactly what the file holds (rows and page, filters, the date range as real dates with a day count, hidden and personal-data columns) with toggles and a one-tap "Export all" or "Mask it" fix.

items.name: invite-check
items.title: Invite Check
items.description: Pre-send invite check that shows the start in each guest's zone, offers the nearest start that suits everyone, and flags night, weekend or holiday slots, typo'd domains, no video link or location, duplicate guests (+tags, Gmail dots) and resent invites.

items.name: large-attachment
items.title: Large Attachment
items.description: Attachment size check against each service's limit, counting email's ~37% Base64 overhead, that marks the fewest files pushing it over and shows the size after sending them as a link or compressing, with an honest estimate for already-compressed files.

items.name: embed-code
items.title: Embed Code
items.description: Reads back what visitors will see and what the embed tracks, offers a privacy mode and allowed-site list, and catches drafts, private resources and secrets in the URL (token=, sig=) with a one-tap strip before a deliberate second click copies it.

items.name: alt-text-check
items.title: Alt Text Check
items.description: Checks each image's alt text for missing text, filenames (IMG_2041.jpg, PXL_…), "image of…" redundancy, caption copies and excess length, with per-image status, one-tap fixes, a decorative toggle and a reminder when the image has words. Post jumps to the first problem.

items.name: stale-reply
items.title: Stale Reply
items.description: Warns "This was 3 weeks ago and 14 newer messages followed" before you reply, surfaces the newest related messages (and any that already settled it, like "fixed in 2.4.1"), and offers to reply to the latest or quote the original.

items.name: tip-picker
items.title: Tip Picker
items.description: Tip picker that says whether the percent is on the pre- or post-tax amount (with a switch), shows each preset in money, flags a service charge already on the bill, and holds back accidental huge tips (250 in the % field, 15 as money, 100%) until fixed or confirmed.

items.name: refund-picker
items.title: Refund Picker
items.description: Refund builder: pick units per item or a capped custom amount, see each restocking and return-shipping deduction, keep non-refundable items visible with the reason, compare each method's net and arrival dates, then read the whole refund back before issuing.

items.name: plan-change-readback
items.title: Plan Change Readback
items.description: Plan change readback that prorates by day (credit, charge today, next bill and date), says a downgrade credit goes to future bills not the card, compares now vs period end, lists lost features, and shows usage over new limits, acknowledged if destructive.

items.name: payment-reference
items.title: Payment Reference
items.description: Reference field that requires the invoice number in the expected format, checks each rail's length and character set (UPI, IMPS, NEFT, Faster Payments), moves a cut-off invoice number to the front, and previews the payee's statement line.

items.name: truncation-preview
items.title: Truncation Preview
items.description: Preview of where LinkedIn, Instagram, X, iOS/Android notifications and Google (by pixel width) cut the text, warning when the key phrase, a link or an @mention X won't notify sits below the fold, with fixes that move that sentence up or remove blank lines.

items.name: dockerfile-check
items.title: Dockerfile Check
items.description: Parses like BuildKit (escape directive, continuations, heredocs, stages) and flags a final image running as root, secrets in ARG or ENV, secret files baked in or copied across stages, COPY . before installs, no .dockerignore, apt-get hygiene, unchecked ADD URLs, curl | sh.

items.name: gitignore-check
items.title: Gitignore Check
items.description: Dependency-free .gitignore checker that applies Git's matching rules to your file list, names the line deciding each file, and flags syntax traps, ineffective ! lines, anchors that miss nested folders, missing .env/key/node_modules entries and already-tracked files.

items.name: workflow-yaml-guard
items.title: Workflow YAML Guard
items.description: GitHub Actions review: pull_request_target or workflow_run jobs that check out PR code, untrusted ${{ github.event.* }} in run scripts, actions on movable tags, missing or write-all permissions, echoed secrets and fork-reachable self-hosted runners, with one-tap fixes.

items.name: iam-policy-check
items.title: IAM Policy Check
items.description: Reads each IAM or S3 bucket policy statement back in plain words (who, what, on what, under which condition) and flags admin and service:* wildcards, Resource "*", Principal "*" that S3 would call public, NotAction/NotPrincipal traps and wide iam:PassRole, with scoped fixes.

items.name: hreflang-check
items.title: Hreflang Check
items.description: Checks pasted <link> tags or a sitemap for one page or a set, following Google Search Central: a who-links-to-whom grid, missing return links, invalid codes (en-UK, es-419), relative URLs, missing self-reference or x-default, and canonicals to another language, with fixes.

items.name: redirect-rule-input
items.title: Redirect Rule Input
items.description: Redirect list checker for vercel.json, Netlify _redirects and nginx rewrite/return. Finds loops, chains, shadowed rules, open redirects, wrong status codes, dropped queries and trailing-slash traps, with a GET/POST tester and one-tap fixes.

items.name: set-cookie-check
items.title: Set-Cookie Check
items.description: Set-Cookie checker that reads back who gets each cookie, over what, cross-site or not and for how long (after the 400-day cap), flagging SameSite=None or Partitioned without Secure, broken __Host-/__Secure- prefixes, wide Domain, missing HttpOnly and size limits.

items.name: qr-scan-check
items.title: QR Scan Check
items.description: Post-scan check showing the real domain against what's printed beside the code (with a go-to-printed-site option), flagging lookalike and brand-borrowing domains, short links (via your resolver), app downloads, and for UPI codes the payee, amount and refund scams.

items.name: env-diff
items.title: Env Diff
items.description: Compares two environments key by key, lists missing and empty keys first, flags production values pointing at localhost, a test key or the staging host, and secrets reused across both, masking every secret behind a short fingerprint.

items.name: join-preview
items.title: Join Preview
items.description: Join preview that predicts the row count for each join type, names repeated keys that fan rows out, counts rows dropped for no match or a blank key, and catches keys that never match (number vs text, spaces, case, leading zeros), with fixes that say how many rows they rescue.

items.name: dedupe-key-picker
items.title: Dedupe Key Picker
items.description: As you pick key columns, previews how many rows merge, names a near-unique column (like a timestamp) that keeps duplicates apart, flags a key so broad one value swallows many rows, keeps blank keys separate and highlights values a merge would discard.

items.name: dual-axis-guard
items.title: Dual Axis Guard
items.description: Catches zero baselines at different heights and independent ranges that make a +15% line and a +140% line climb together, states each series' real change, and offers one-tap "index both to 100" on one scale (your chart library via render prop, or built-in SVG).

items.name: secret-field
items.title: Secret Field
items.description: Read-only secret display that keeps the readable prefix (sk_live_, ghp_) and last characters, flags Live or Test keys, re-masks on a timer or when the tab is hidden, and makes copying the masked text put the real key on the clipboard.

items.name: text-diff
items.title: Text Diff
items.description: Word-level diff (Myers) that calls out changed numbers (30 → 14) and draws invisible changes like doubled spaces, line breaks and zero-width characters, in inline or split view, and stays fast on long documents with small changes.

items.name: readback
items.title: Readback
items.description: Read-out display for license keys, IBANs and Wi-Fi passwords that groups characters, labels every look-alike (zero vs letter O, one vs small L), copies the clean value and offers a large show-to-someone view.

items.name: copy-confirm
items.title: Copy Confirm
items.description: Shows exactly what was copied, refuses to copy an empty value, flags stray whitespace and invisible characters with a one-tap clean copy, and can copy formatted numbers as plain text.

items.name: middle-truncate
items.title: Middle Truncate
items.description: Text that truncates in the middle to the real rendered width so the distinguishing end (a file extension, the last characters of an ID) stays visible, while copy, title and screen readers always get the full value. Never splits emoji or accents.

items.name: precise-number
items.title: Precise Number
items.description: Compact number display (₹1.2 Cr, $1.2M) that cuts instead of rounding up, puts the exact value in a tooltip that isn't clipped by tables or scroll areas, gives spoken units, offers a lakh/crore toggle that rolls the figure to its new units, and keeps percentages honest.

items.name: unambiguous-date
items.title: Unambiguous Date
items.description: Date display that writes dates as "3 Oct 2026" with distance from today, flags numeric inputs that read two ways (DD/MM vs MM/DD) with a one-tap choice, and lets one answer apply to a whole imported column.

items.name: deadline
items.title: Deadline
items.description: Shows time left plus the exact moment in your zone and the owner's, writes midnight as the end of the day before, and turns amber when close and red when overdue.

items.name: change-highlight
items.title: Change Highlight
items.description: Flashes a change once (at most once a second, skipped under reduced motion), keeps a ▲/▼ with good/bad colour and the previous value in a tooltip, and can tell returning visitors what changed since their last visit.

items.name: spell-out
items.title: Spell Out
items.description: Readable display for booking refs, wallet addresses, keys and passwords: grouped characters, look-alikes named under the glyph (0 zero vs O oh, 1/l/I, 5/S), NATO spelling with case when it matters, and Cyrillic look-alikes and invisible characters flagged.

items.name: honest-bar
items.title: Honest Bar
items.description: Pure-SVG bar chart that, when the axis doesn't start at zero, draws a broken-axis mark, states the distortion (lie factor) with a one-tap Start at 0, tears and labels values past the scale, and reads exact values on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: change-readout
items.title: Change Readout
items.description: Shows a change both ways (₹1,200 → ₹1,500 · +₹300 · +25%), keeps percentage points apart from percent (4% → 6% is +2 pts, +50%), gives no % from a zero base or across zero, divides by |base| for negatives, adds 2.5× when a value at least doubles and marks good or bad.

items.name: size-context
items.title: Size Context
items.description: File size readback with a relatable comparison, transfer time and the equivalent in the other unit system (including what Windows shows), plus a limit check that flags the grey zone where a "4 GB" limit fits only if the service means GiB.

items.name: sum-check
items.title: Sum Check
items.description: Total checker that re-adds rows in exact integer arithmetic, shows the off-by amount, points at rows that would explain it (swapped digits, slipped decimal, flipped sign, debit on the credit side) and says when the gap is only rounding, with a one-tap use-the-sum fix.

items.name: status-chip
items.title: Status Chip
items.description: Status chip with a distinct icon shape and text per tone, a colour-blind-safe (Okabe-Ito) palette, one shared status map so meanings stay consistent, and a hover/focus tooltip explaining what the status means and what to do next.

items.name: sort-indicator
items.title: Sort Indicator
items.description: Sortable header plus a readback that states the sort in plain words ("Sorted by Due date, oldest first"), warns when the order comes from a hidden column, empty values or pinned rows, and animates rows to their new place so a re-sort can be followed.

items.name: diff-table
items.title: Diff Table
items.description: Marks cells that actually differ (ignoring case, spacing and 10 GB vs 10GB), offers "Show only differences" with a count of hidden identical rows, and shows blank cells as "Not stated", never a dash that reads as "No".

items.name: amount-in-words
items.title: Amount in Words
items.description: Names every digit group (2 lakh · 50 thousand), spells the amount cheque-style in lakh/crore or million with paise or cents, can show the other number system alongside, and checks typed words against the figure.

items.name: overflow-list
items.title: Overflow List
items.description: Chip list or avatar stack that collapses to "+N more" but always keeps failed items, the signed-in user and pinned items visible, and spells out what the expand button hides ("+4 more, 1 skipped") instead of a bare count.

items.name: honest-rating
items.title: Honest Rating
items.description: Rating summary showing review count and star breakdown, flagging small samples with a likely range for the true score, calling out love-it-or-hate-it splits, and exposing a disclosed Bayesian score for sorting so a 5.0 from 3 reviews can't outrank a 4.6 from 900.

items.name: unit-price
items.title: Unit Price
items.description: Pack comparison on a common unit price (₹ per 100 g, per litre or per piece) that marks the true cheapest and catches bigger packs costing more per unit, multi-buys dearer than singles and packs that shrank at the same price, with a one-tap switch.

items.name: abbr-hint
items.title: Abbr Hint
items.description: Makes each abbreviation a dotted, tappable, keyboard-focusable hint instead of a hover-only <abbr title>, can spell it out on first use, exposes the expansion to screen readers, and flags terms missing from the glossary. The hint is portalled and flips to stay on screen.

items.name: error-explainer
items.title: Error Explainer
items.description: Says what happened, the likely cause and one next step, waits out Retry-After, warns that an ambiguous timeout on a payment may already have gone through with Check status before Retry, and gives a copyable support reference with technical details tucked away.

items.name: partial-period
items.title: Partial Period
items.description: Period comparison that compares like for like (yesterday cut at the same minute) by default, warns when the full period is chosen, hatches the bucket still filling, dims the part of yesterday not yet reached, and projects the finish, labelled as an estimate.

items.name: gap-aware-line
items.title: Gap-Aware Line
items.description: Pure-SVG line chart that breaks the line at null readings, shades and labels each gap, keeps a lone reading between gaps as a dot, draws estimated points hollow with dashed segments, and backs every reading with a data table.

items.name: fair-rank
items.title: Fair Rank
items.description: Ranks ties the standard competition way (1, T-2, T-2, 4) at the precision shown so equal-looking scores share a rank, shows movement since last period, and sets aside entries below a minimum sample with the reason and the rank they would have had.

items.name: eta-range
items.title: ETA Range
items.description: Quotes the range covering 90% of deliveries, with a most likely day only when one stands out ("Thu 15 – Sat 17 Oct, most likely Fri 16"), counts business days, holidays and the cutoff in the shipper's zone, previews the post-cutoff range and explains when it widened.

items.name: palette-guard
items.title: Palette Guard
items.description: Chart palette check that simulates protan, deutan and tritan vision (Machado 2009), flags every pair under a CIEDE2000 threshold, and offers the smallest lightness-only fix that clears all clashes, or patterns and direct labels when no colour change can.

items.name: use-bollard-field
items.title: useBollardField
items.description: Library-agnostic React field validation state for Bollard, shadcn/ui, or custom controls. Supports sync and async validation without rendering or styling a component.
